metadata.title: PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0 inputs, restricted part: CPLM 4.0 lysine methylation download and derived tables
metadata.description: The CPLM 4.0 Methylation download (downloaded 2026-10-18; member Methylation.txt dated 2021-06-13) used by PTM_Pipeline for lysine-methylation marks, and the tables scripts/39_stage_cplm4_lys_methylation.py made from it. CPLM 4.0 states "All Rights Reserved" and gives no licence, so these files are kept with restricted access for verification only. Cite Zhang W et al., Nucleic Acids Res 50:D451-D459 (2022), doi:10.1093/nar/gkab849.
metadata.access_conditions: Access only to verify or reproduce PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0. The data belong to The CUCKOO Workgroup (CPLM 4.0, all rights reserved); obtain them from https://cplm.biocuckoo.cn for any other use.
